svg.title: Raiders PSL Resale Fee Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-psl-resale-fee-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Raiders PSL Resale Fee Funnel; subtitle: How a $10,000 seat-license sale splits between buyer, seller and marketplace; caption: A single $10,000 Raiders PSL transaction on the official marketplace, from buyer all-in cost down to the per-side fee floor.; assumptions note: Fee structure is the Raiders' official marketplace FAQ as read by THE MARKUP FILES; any outstanding PSL loan payoff comes out on top of the seller net shown.; note: Source: THE MARKUP FILES (rT4gQkoEVDI @ 00:12:53 and 00:13:14). Offer-route context: TicketWire (M80btlo7xJc @ 00:01:48) reports $3,000 to $4,000 saved by making a lowball offer instead of paying asking.; stages: label: Buyer all-in cost; value: 11200; display: $11,200; conversion: Starting point; detail: Negotiated price plus the 12% buyer fee.; label: Negotiated PSL price; value: 10000; display: $10,000; conversion: 12% buyer fee removed; detail: The headline sale price both sides agree on.; label: Seller net proceeds; value: 8800; display: $8,800; conversion: 12% seller fee removed; detail: Net before any outstanding loan payoff.; label: Combined marketplace fee take; value: 2400; display: Almost $2,400; conversion: Both sides combined; detail: Total fees on a single $10,000 transaction.; label: Per-side fee floor; value: 250; display: $250 minimum; conversion: Applies to small sales; detail: Minimum fee charged on each side of the trade.

circle.title: label: Buyer all-in cost; value: 11200; display: $11,200; conversion: Starting point; detail: Negotiated price plus the 12% buyer fee.
label: Negotiated PSL price; value: 10000; display: $10,000; conversion: 12% buyer fee removed; detail: The headline sale price both sides agree on.
label: Seller net proceeds; value: 8800; display: $8,800; conversion: 12% seller fee removed; detail: Net before any outstanding loan payoff.
label: Combined marketplace fee take; value: 2400; display: Almost $2,400; conversion: Both sides combined; detail: Total fees on a single $10,000 transaction.
label: Per-side fee floor; value: 250; display: $250 minimum; conversion: Applies to small sales; detail: Minimum fee charged on each side of the trade.

text.title: Assumptions: Fee structure is the Raiders' official marketplace FAQ as read by THE MARKUP FILES; any outstanding PSL loan payoff comes out on top of the seller net shown.
